predecessor_no_go.st2_failure: both families fail +0.001 matched-control margin and cross-OS exact checkpoint SHA; no retuning

scientific_question: Can a novel native bounded intervention-credit substrate infer hidden immediate and delayed causal laws from public action consequences, retain this knowledge, and transfer it to unfamiliar action laws better than fully trained same-information conventional and count controls?
north_star: Independent native tokenless non-transformer causal learning; do not confuse source-free development with general intelligence.

source.name: Eight-bit reversible hidden-law switchboard with one-step delayed actuator
source.law: For hidden integer law_id, rotate=1+(law_id%3), action masks a0/a1/a2 are SHA256 UTF8('NCI04-ST3|'+str(law_id)+'|'+str(a)) first digest byte. At t x_next=ROTL8(x_t,rotate) XOR mask[action] for action 0/1 (else 0) XOR pending_t. pending_next=mask[2] only if action==2 else 0. Action 3 no-op except pre-existing pending and rotation. Law, masks, rotation, pending are source-private.
source.observation: 8 public bits x_t; prior observed public next-change bits, previously chosen actions and current announced action 0..3; all learners share exact same source histories.
source.target: After original source step, eight public changed bits x_t XOR x_next, never hidden source law/pending/reward.
source.actor: Blinded fixed 64-step schedule: if seed even, action=(t+seed%4)%4; if odd, action=(3-(t+seed%4))%4; never responds to law or model forecasts.

stage0: SOURCE ONLY before any candidate training: verify >=8 exact current public observation/action aliases with different resulting public outcomes across hidden laws, nonzero action2 delayed effects under follow-up action3 for >=2 law IDs, and correct source state/action determinism. No hidden law to actor/learner. If this fails stop without seed/law search.
mechanism: New eight-cell integer-state intervention-conditioned local causal hypothesis register: separate immediate and one-step delayed action/outcome credit, bounded explicit uncertainty and contradiction repair, exact reversible cold snapshot; not ST1 routing, ST2 appearance cache, transformer, token model or privileged world oracle. Freeze implementation and capacity before source development scoring.
comparators: Fully trained 45-coefficient 8-state conventional recurrent, same trajectories and actions
Same-resource 8x4x2 causal action count predictor with matched memory budget
Same candidate with fixed action permutation prior to update (sham)
Same candidate with episodic memory erasure
Unmatched hidden-law oracle, clearly diagnostic only
metric: Held-development preaction 8-bit Brier, lower better, per unseen law and pooled; separate delayed action2->3 slices, interference/cold retention, same-trajectory source SHA, integer state SHA, resource/cost parity.
frozen_go: Candidate pooled held Brier >=0.02 absolute lower than best matched fully trained recurrent AND count controls and better in >=3/4 held laws. Delayed-slice Brier >=0.02 better than both intervention-credit ablation and action-shuffle sham. Retain >=95% prior-law accuracy after 8 unrelated-law episodes without additional fitting. Actual action consequences drive nonzero learning. Exact cross-OS integer state and original source traces. Full source+actor+learner wall <=1.5x best control, disclose CPU/peak RSS/memory and no hidden information. Any failed condition DEV_NO_GO.
scientific_limit: In-house task can only support DEV, not independent source transfer or SCIENTIFIC_PASS. New external independent source, fresh sealed qualification, full regression and G29 separately required before any promotion.
